[!dolt] skip
# Test bd duplicate and bd supersede close the old issue and link it
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Canonical bug' --description 'Primary report' --type bug --json
extractid CANONICAL
bd create 'Duplicate bug' --description 'Secondary report' --type bug --json
extractid DUPLICATE

bd duplicate $DUPLICATE --of $CANONICAL --json
jq '.canonical'
stdout "$CANONICAL"
jq '.status'
stdout '"closed"'

bd show $DUPLICATE --json
jq '.[0].issue.status'
stdout '"closed"'

bd create 'Replacement spec' --description 'New version' --type decision --json
extractid REPLACEMENT
bd create 'Old spec' --description 'Superseded version' --type decision --json
extractid OLD

bd supersede $OLD --with $REPLACEMENT --json
jq '.replacement'
stdout "$REPLACEMENT"
jq '.status'
stdout '"closed"'

bd show $OLD --json
jq '.[0].issue.status'
stdout '"closed"'
